regions.merged_text: I was going to say, when we think of past blessings and merciful providence -- notwithstand- ing our sins -- whereby God has blessed us, why should we not foster confidence by thanking Him for the future also. Conclusion : Simply I hope you get a kind of "kick out of this. I never intended as much, but O! what God must have ahead of us if we only leave all to His planning !
